title: Yusuf
tagline: His whole story in thirteen chapters, with something to do in every one.
depictionNotes: No person is drawn. Yusuf appears as a warm glow, his brothers as a huddle of dots. The events in the governor's house (12:23-34) and the second prisoner's dream (12:41) are told in softened, child-level words; the game's 'For parents' note says exactly how.
